'''Kaal''' was a member of the [[77th Air Wing]]'s [[Sword Squadron (Imperial)|Sword Squadron]]. During the [[Battle of Kelrodo-Ai]] in the [[Western Reaches Operation]] of the [[Reconquest of the Rim]], Kaal served as [[Scimitar Flight]]'s leader. He was killed, alongside the rest of Scimitar Flight, by a colony of [[Unidentified tentacle creature (Kelrodo-Ai)|creatures]] during an initial attempt at infiltrating the shaft leading down to the [[Hypermatter reactor/Legends|hypermatter annihilator]].
